cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: You First
cards.instruction: Coax someone else into breaking a rule before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved a rooftop photograph for your wedding. You may lead us through that staff-only door.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you go first? They'll notice my dress.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request to lead is confirmed. A bride of your standing will be forgiven; I'll follow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Assistance is granted. I'll take the far end. You may make your entrance before any part of me crosses that threshold.

reason: Turn B request for A to lead into a deliberately self-serving approval of B precedence, then grant assistance that still keeps A behind the rule breach.
